answer: Connection-oriented cluster matching (COCM): when a knoll of endorsers backs an answer, each endorser's weight is discounted by how much timber they already share with the others: common vouches, a funding root, or past co-attestation. A voyage of clones backing each other overlaps almost totally, so their combined match shrinks toward one identity, while unconnected strangers each add near-full weight. Splitting into more sybils adds overlap, not weight.
